description: Field rename email_address -> email applied to models.py and api.py but NOT notify.py. The omission class of bug: invisible in the hunks, fatal at runtime.

seeded_bugs.why: send_welcome reads user.email_address, which no longer exists after the rename -> AttributeError on every welcome email. Catchable only by hunting what the diff failed to change.

noise_traps.must_not: be flagged without the [pre-existing] prefix -- the broad except Exception: pass predates the diff and no line of legacy.py was touched
be flagged at all -- 'import os' is unused but that is linter territory, even though models.py is in the changed set
